results.title: What is a Business Opportunity?
results.content:
A new technology that can be used in existing markets is referred to as a technological opportunity in the business world.

 ### Competitive Opportunity

Taking advantage of a competitive opportunity means offering new products or services that can surpass those of your competitors. The goal here is to encourage their current customers to switch to your business instead.
